## 3. Guard harness (`guards.sh`) — G1–G5, must be 5/5

```bash
[ "$n" -eq 0 ]

# G2: README route set == live OpenAPI route set (exact diff)
jq -r '.paths | keys[] | select(startswith("/v1/ingest"))' /tmp/openapi-live.json | sort > /tmp/live.txt
grep -oE '/v1/ingest/[a-z/]+' README.md | sort -u | diff -q - /tmp/live.txt

# G3: stack-overview table == 8 service rows AND "all eight services" text present
# G4: each of the 8 guide services exists in compose.yaml with 8 healthchecks total
# G5: live probe — bare POST /v1/ingest → 404; POST /v1/ingest/message → 401 with
#     content-type application/json (route exists); with key → 202
```

2. **G2 exact set-match** — README has all 4 live routes and *no extras* (diff clean), so the fix can't drift into inventing routes.

**Failures deliberately demonstrated:** guards initially ran 3/5 then 4/5 due to guard-harness bugs (not doc bugs), and the first git surgery produced docs→baseline ordering — both corrected to the final clean state above.
